description: Wrap a source TOP in a Corner Pin warp for projection mapping: drag the four corner handles to line the image up with a physical surface (wall, object, screen). The source comes in through a Select TOP so it can live anywhere; output is a Null ready for setup_output. The corner positions are parameters, so you can also drive or save them.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'projection' container is created inside.

source_path.description: TOP to map (brought in via a Select TOP). Omit for a demo grid source.

name: create_projection_mapping
title: Create projection mapping
